seo.title: Trade Wind Timepieces | Independent Watch Sourcing
seo.description: Trade Wind Timepieces LLC — independent sourcing and sales of exceptional pre-owned watches.

hero.headline: Timepieces
hero.intro: Trade Wind Timepieces connects collectors with exceptional watches through a personal, considered approach.

about.heading: A personal way to find your next watch.
about.body: We are an independent watch business focused on individual transactions and lasting relationships. Whether you have a particular reference in mind or are exploring what comes next, the conversation starts with the watch and what matters to you.
about.brands: We source exceptional timepieces: Rolex, Audemars Piguet, Patek Philippe, Omega, Breitling, Tudor, and other distinguished watchmakers.

items.title: Buying
items.text: Thinking of parting with a watch? We purchase quality pre-owned timepieces with a straightforward offer and a clear, discreet process.

items.title: Selling
items.text: Exceptional pre-owned watches, each presented with clear details on condition, provenance, and what is included.

items.title: Consignment
items.text: Let us present your watch to collectors on your behalf, with terms agreed up front and updates along the way.

items.title: Personal sourcing
items.text: Tell us the reference you are after. We draw on our network to find the right example for you.

steps.title: Tell us what you seek
steps.text: A particular model, a reference family, or a direction you want to explore.

steps.title: Review the details
steps.text: Discuss condition, provenance, included accessories, and the terms of the individual watch.

steps.title: Make a considered choice
steps.text: Take the time you need to decide whether it is the right piece for you.

contact.heading: YOUR NEXT WATCH BEGINS WITH A CONVERSATION
contact.text: Ask Bill about current availability or a watch you are looking for.

footer.disclaimer: Independent dealer. Not affiliated with the watch brands referenced here.
